units.source_text: 五公主那里，源氏逢时逢节亦必致送礼物。

en.t: Genji also made sure to send gifts to the Fifth Princess on every suitable occasion and seasonal festival.

units.source_text: 五公主衷心感激，便极口赞誉他：“这位公子，我看见他不多几天之前还是个孩子呢。

en.t: The Fifth Princess was deeply grateful and praised him lavishly: "This young gentleman seemed to me to be only a child just a few days ago.

units.source_text: 谁知一眨眼，已经变成大人，礼数如此周到了。

en.t: Who would have thought that in the blink of an eye he would already have become a grown man, so perfectly attentive to every courtesy.

units.source_text: 况且相貌长得漂亮之极，心地比谁都善良呢！”

en.t: Besides, he is extraordinarily handsome, and his heart is kinder than anyone else's!"

units.source_text: 青年侍女们听了都掩口而笑。

en.t: When the young gentlewomen heard this, they all covered their mouths and laughed.
